# Coastal Roadworks

> Coastal Roadworks LLC is a commercial parking lot striping and pavement
> maintenance company serving Houston, Harris County, Montgomery County, and
> surrounding Texas areas. Owner-led, fully insured, 5.0-rated on Google.
> Phone: 361-876-7822. Email: CoastalRoadworks@gmail.com.

Coastal Roadworks stripes new parking lot layouts, restripes faded lots,
repairs asphalt and potholes, fills cracks, installs wheel stops and parking
signage, and paints pavement markings (fire lanes, curbs, crosswalks,
accessible/ADA markings, stencils). Much of the work is done at night or in
phases so businesses stay open. All photography and video on the site is of
the company's own job sites, including specialty work such as helipad
markings.

## Services

- [Parking Lot Striping](https://coastalroadworks.com/parking-lot-striping/): new layouts and restripes for retail, office, apartment, and industrial properties
- [Asphalt & Pothole Repair](https://coastalroadworks.com/asphalt-repair/): targeted, compacted repairs that stop deterioration
- [Crack Filling](https://coastalroadworks.com/crack-filling/): sealing cracks to keep water out of the pavement base
- [Wheel Stops & Signage](https://coastalroadworks.com/wheel-stops-and-signage/): wheel stop installation and posted traffic signs
- [Pavement Markings](https://coastalroadworks.com/pavement-markings/): fire lanes, painted curbs, crosswalks, accessible markings, stencils
